scope: Local application; latest teammate commits integrated; no deployment

visibility_definition.observer_origin: selected DEM elevation plus declared height along local vertical; independent of decorative spacecraft scale

locale_invariance: Changing language preserves NASA results, UTC instants and requirements
limits: Finite DEM angular sampling and partial distant coverage.
Angular profiles do not locate the terrain point defining the horizon.
The illustrative 3D bodies do not calculate a visible disk fraction or an RF link budget.
Native energy and terrain operations require the local Python API and NASA rasters.
